dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Cupcake was surrendered as a stray so we have no history on his behavior in a home environment. Cupcake has shown fearful behavior while at the care center, displaying a tucked tail and body around handlers, and panting and pacing in new or unknown spaces. He has also shown reluctance to exit his kennel. Due to his fearfulness, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Cupcake
